followUps.subject: Clarification required for GST invoice ABC/091 — October 2026 Reconciliation
followUps.emailBody:
Dear ABC Distributors Team,

We are reconciling our purchase records for October 2026 and could not locate a corresponding invoice entry in the GSTR-2B data currently available to us.

Could you please verify the invoice details below and confirm whether any correction or reporting update is required?

Invoice Number: ABC/091
Invoice Date: 12 October 2026
Taxable Value: ₹55,000
Total Tax (CGST + SGST): ₹9,900

Regards,
Accounts Team — Eastern Retail Solutions
followUps.whatsappBody: Hello ABC Distributors team, we are reconciling Oct 2026 GST records for Eastern Retail Solutions. Invoice ABC/091 (dt 12 Oct 2026, Taxable ₹55,000, Tax ₹9,900) was not found in our uploaded GSTR-2B. Could you please confirm its reporting status?
